mapper.select: SELECT MARKET, DESCRIPTION FROM MARKET_MASTER ORDER BY MARKET

SELECT DISTINCT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID
AND u.USERID = #{userId}
AND u.USERID IN (SELECT USERID FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR WHERE USERNAME = #{user})
AND a.MARKET = #{market}
AND u.USERID IN (SELECT USERID FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH WHERE `FUNCTION` = 'RULES')
AND u.USERID IN (SELECT USERID FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH WHERE `FUNCTION` = 'TEMPLATE')
ORDER BY u.USERID
